items.headline: 16-unit apartment building permitted on Bradford Way
items.summary: A $1.8 million permit was issued for new construction of a 16-unit multi-family building at 1803 Bradford Wy, one of the larger housing permits in this batch.

items.headline: Law firm Cleary Gottlieb signage permitted downtown
items.summary: A permit was issued for a black aluminum channel-letter sign reading 'Cleary Gottlieb' at 151 University Ave, signaling the law firm's move into a downtown storefront.

items.headline: Two prefab ADUs permitted near same building on Rubino Drive
items.summary: Villa Homes received permits for two prefabricated multi-family ADUs (#121 and #123) near Building D at 3180 Rubino Dr, each valued around $117,000, suggesting a coordinated ADU rollout at this property rather than a one-off addition.

items.headline: PopUp Bagels signage permitted at 164 University Ave
items.summary: A permit was issued for a non-illuminated canopy sign and hanging sign for 'PopUp Bagels' at 164 University Ave, indicating the bagel chain is preparing to open a location on University Avenue.
